data.title: Supreme Court rules in challenge to Iowa's new bitcoin law - Radio Iowa
data.description: The Iowa Supreme Court has ruled in a case involving a bitcoin scam.  A man learned he had been scammed after depositing $11,500 dollars into a bitcoin ATM in Cedar Falls in August of 2024. Cedar Falls police seized the cash from the machine and the bitcoin company filed to get the money after police […]
data.author: Dar Danielson
